newsitem.title: HONG KONG: South African Airways adds extra HK flight.
newsitem.headline: South African Airways adds extra HK flight.

text.p: South African Airways is due to start a fourth weekly frequency between Johannesburg and Hong Kong on February 15, an airline spokeswoman said.
The additional Boeing 747-200 flight arrives in the territory on Saturday afternoons and returns on Sunday night via Bangkok.

The airline said the extra flight is because of extra passenger demand in Hong Kong and follows the termination of flights to Taipei because of the new political alliance between South Africa and China. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
